method: Whole-file manual reading of five animation/resource files, pinned bytes verified. Manifest XML parsed. No Windows execution.
findings: Animation inactivity threshold750ms sets moving false but still draws a sleeping figure; Stop sets done and suppresses figure after optional background fill. This indicator is not a worker-completion or scan-settled oracle.

Suspension rebases timestamps so resume avoids a large movement delta. Empty outer rectangles rebase draw time and return; positive outer rectangles are later deflated without a second size check, so very small controls can produce nonpositive drawing geometry. Actual GDI+ handling unqualified.

Position uses modulo-two reflection, with finite nonnegative diff and position0..1 assumed by assertions. No per-instance timer or repaint scheduler appears in these files; caller drives updates and draws.
Static global suspension and shared font cache have no synchronization here. GUI-thread use is assumed; source does not prove arbitrary-thread safety. Font cache refreshes by font percentage.

Manifest declares dpiAware true, longPathAware, SegmentHeap and asInvoker with uiAccess false, plus Windows compatibility identifiers. These declarations do not establish runtime long-path or per-monitor-DPI correctness.
Resource version file contains MIT permission text, while animation and rc2 carry GPL-3.0-or-later identifiers. Per-file licensing must be preserved; no production code adopted.
Version resource constructs four-part numeric file/product versions and a three-part product-version string; metadata is generated from macros, not verification of executable contents.
limits: No native rendering, animation timing, tiny-control, concurrency, resource compilation or installed-executable validation performed.
Native pHash investigation remains deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
